noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

parsed.description:
Method name to be used to access parsed representation of a field with `serialized` reference.

E.g.
```
type Link {
  @implicit(parsed='toDest')
  to: string serialized Dest
}
```
will produce:
```
  toDest: cached member function(): Dest
```
instead of default:
```
  parsedDest: cached member function(): Dest
```

title: Annotation to alter some of the implicit Type System semantics
name: Ann.Implicit
